description: Focused repeat of the 16-point affine Grover-Rudolph distribution with light Runtime mitigation. This is still distribution measurement only, with no QAE amplification.
rationale: The first distribution campaign measured gr_affine_n4 with TVD 0.047882, above the Phase 0-GR noisy estimate 0.028098.
The n=3 circuits were stable, so the next hardware action should focus on the first 16-point circuit only.
4096 shots reduce sampling uncertainty while keeping the campaign small.
Dynamical decoupling and twirling test whether the observed TVD is reducible without changing the Grover-Rudolph loader.

selected_cases.label: affine positive density, 16 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Focused 16-point Grover-Rudolph distribution repeat with Runtime mitigation.

stopping_rules: Do not add QAE amplification until this repeat is retrieved and compared to the first gr_affine_n4 readout.
If TVD remains near 0.05 or worsens, perform a layout/seed audit for gr_affine_n4 before further QPU use.
If TVD drops toward the Phase 0 noisy estimate, use the same Runtime options for the first amplified n=4 test.
